summary: DigiAsia Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 60-day extension of the long-stop date for its proposed transaction with PayMate India Limited, originally disclosed on May 9, 2026. The multi-step deal involves a Share Purchase Agreement, Coordination Deed, and Letter Agreement. No revised terms were provided; conditions include funding, regulatory approvals, consents, closing mechanics, and shareholder approval. DigiAsia expects closing within 60 days but offers no assurance. The extension agreement was filed as Exhibit 16.1. Watch for regulatory and shareholder approvals and funding completion, with risk-arb angle centered on closing uncertainty.
